The **dearth** of local expertise in renewable energy technologies has forced the project team to rely heavily on external consultants, despite initial budget constraints.

The **repercussions** of the policy change were immediate, with immediate feedback showing both positive shifts in consumer behaviour and unexpected economic disruptions.
